title: Define RDS Subnet Groups and Security Groups
description: Create isolated database subnets and define Security Groups allowing ingress only from the Fargate service security group on port 5432.
acceptance_criteria: DB Subnet Group covering 3 AZs; Security Group allows ingress only from App SG

title: Configure Aurora Serverless v2 Cluster Construct
description: Define the DatabaseCluster using ServerlessV2 engine mode. Configure scaling range (0.5 ACU to 16 ACU) and IAM authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Cluster defined with ServerlessV2; Min ACU 0.5; Max ACU 16; IAM Auth enabled

title: Implement Secrets Manager & Credential Rotation
description: Create a DatabaseSecret attached to the cluster. Configure automatic rotation using a standard Lambda rotator.
acceptance_criteria: Secret created; Rotation schedule configured; Fargate role permission granted

title: Design Sync API Contract & DTOs
description: Define the JSON payload structure for batch synchronization, including client timestamps for conflict resolution.
acceptance_criteria: OpenAPI spec defined; DTOs support batch ops; Timestamp field included

title: Implement Connectivity Monitoring Service
description: Create a service using connectivity_plus to listen for network state changes and expose a stream of connection status.
acceptance_criteria: Detects Online/Offline; Exposes Riverpod provider; Debounces state changes

title: Implement Apple App Store JWS Webhook Verification
description: Implement logic to parse and validate the JSON Web Signature (JWS) from Apple Server Notifications V2.
acceptance_criteria: Validates cert chain; Verifies signature; Extracts notification type

title: Implement ReadingSession Domain Logic
description: Create the ReadingSession entity, Value Objects, and Domain Events. Configure EF Core mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Entity encapsulated; EF Core Config implemented; Migration created

title: Implement Last-Write-Wins Conflict Resolution Strategy
description: Implement logic to compare incoming batch items against existing DB records using ClientTimestamp.
acceptance_criteria: Older timestamp ignored; Newer overwrites; Logic isolated and testable

title: Implement Batch Sync Command Handler
description: Create MediatR command handler to process the batch sync request inside a transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Transactional integrity; Idempotency supported; Returns updated state

title: Implement Pending Items Queue Logic
description: Extend Isar repositories to query for items with syncStatus == pending. Gather into batch payload.
acceptance_criteria: Queries unsynced items; Constructs batch DTO; Handles large datasets

title: Implement Synchronization Orchestrator
description: Create the main SyncService that triggers on connectivity, calls queue logic, and sends data via API.
acceptance_criteria: Triggers on reconnect; Updates local Isar to synced on 200 OK; Handles 401

title: Implement Google Play Real-time Notification Handler
description: Implement logic to handle Pub/Sub messages from Google Play. Decode Base64 data and verify token.
acceptance_criteria: Decodes Pub/Sub; Calls Google API; Handles test notifications

title: Implement Integration Tests for Sync Flow
description: Develop integration tests using TestContainers (Postgres) to verify full sync lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Coverage for create/update/conflict; Runs against real Postgres; Concurrency tested

title: Implement Exponential Backoff & Retry Logic
description: Enhance SyncService to handle transient network failures with exponential backoff strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Retries failed requests; Stops after max attempts; No retry on 4xx

title: Implement Subscription State Management Service
description: Logic to update user role based on validated webhook events (RENEWAL, EXPIRATION, CANCELLATION).
acceptance_criteria: Updates user role in DB; Logs audit event; Handles out-of-order events

title: Configure SQS Dead Letter Queue & Retry Policy
description: Infrastructure code to ensure failed webhooks are retried and eventually moved to a DLQ.
acceptance_criteria: Retries 3 times; Moves to DLQ; CloudWatch alarm configured

title: Integration Testing for Webhook Flow
description: End-to-end integration tests mocking Apple/Google payloads hitting the API and verifying DB updates.
